Due to an ongoing demonstration in downtown Halifax, George Street, between Barrington Street and Hollis Street, is closed to vehicular traffic. Granville Street, between Salter Street and Geroge Street, is also closed to vehicle traffic.

Please use alternate routes to avoid delays.
